profile.headline: SDET / QA and Data Engineer at Infosys
profile.summary: Senior SDET who combines quality engineering, data engineering, and deep enterprise-systems experience. For 5+ years at Infosys, trusted by Capital Group to ensure investment-performance data is accurate before it reaches the business: designing test strategy, automating with Java and Python, validating data end-to-end in SQL, and debugging across .NET, Python, Angular, and AWS Kubernetes until root causes are fixed. Brings 13+ years of experience as an SAP HCM Consultant and ABAP Developer, testing and delivering payroll and time systems for global organizations. Early adopter of AI in QA, using Claude Code and Generative AI to design tests faster and automate production comparisons. AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner and Infosys Certified Java SE8 Developer.  Committed to "taking ownership," "delivering with pride," and "succeeding together."

positions.title: QA Engineer / Data Engineer
positions.description:
Remote / Arlington, VA • Jul 2023 – Present • Capital Markets
Quality Engineering
*Own quality for a capital-markets investment-data platform, from story analysis to sign-off: functional, regression, integration, and UI testing in Agile sprints, managed in qTest.
*Completed 160+ work items, including 50+ user stories.
*Use Claude Code and Generative AI to speed up test design, execution, and evidence for every sprint.
*Built an AI-assisted workflow that compares each cycle's output files against production data via SQL, flagging gaps, tracing root causes, and driving defects to resolution.
*Prove migrated AWS Kubernetes and Python jobs are production-ready through prod-parallel and parity testing.
*Debug .NET, Python, and Angular with Datadog, Splunk, and Aptakube logs; retest fixes and support production hotfixes.
*Validate REST APIs with Postman and confirm results at the database level.
*Caught critical defects in production code and led the root cause analysis through to the fixes.
*Act as quality lead for developers, analysts, and offshore teams.

Data Engineering
*Migrate batch jobs from on-prem SSIS to AWS Kubernetes (EKS), owning analysis, development, and unit testing.
*Rebuild SSIS packages and Informatica IDQ rules as reusable, testable Python ETL and data-quality checks.
*Write SQL/T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and MERGE statements for Microsoft SQL Server.
*Re-engineered Autosys schedules so fund and ETF publications reach consumers earlier.
*Fixed a data-security gap in the shared ETL library that exposed SQL statements in job logs.
*Run production releases end-to-end through XLRelease and Harness CI/CD with ServiceNow change gates.
Automate operational reporting with Python and C# /.NET.
*Environment: Python, SQL Server / T-SQL, AWS (EKS, S3), Docker, Harness, SSIS, Autosys, C# / .NET, Angular, Splunk, DataDog, Aptakube, Postman, qTest, JIRA

positions.title: SDET / QA Engineer
positions.description:
Remote / Arlington, VA • Sep 2021 – Jun 2023 • Capital Markets
*Automated regression testing with Selenium WebDriver and Cucumber (BDD) in Java, using TestNG and JUnit, making test runs faster and more repeatable.
*Validated event-driven trade flows end-to-end over Kafka and RabbitMQ: message publication, consumption, and downstream state changes.
*Tested REST APIs with Postman and Swagger for service contracts, payloads, and error handling.
*Validate data integrity across integrated trading systems by cross-validating results with SQL against Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server.
*Isolated failures in containerized services through Oracle OpenShift and Splunk log analysis.
*Designed and executed test scenarios for 50+ user stories, partnering with business analysts and developers before development started.
*Drove defects to closure in JIRA and supported urgent fixes across environments, including production.
*Onboarded offshore teams through knowledge transfer of the application ecosystem and test scenarios.
*Environment: Java, Selenium, Cucumber, TestNG, JUnit, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Postman, Swagger, PL/SQL, Oracle, MS SQL, OpenShift, Splunk, AWS, Bitbucket, Unix, JIRA

positions.title: SAP HCM Consultant
positions.description:
•Responsible for working closely with business process and product owners, other ITSD module owners and Production Managers to deliver HCM solutions.
•Managed and monitored/tracked, delivered solutions to ensure fit with overall technology and business direction.
•Influenced and supported the enterprise architecture approach and governance model with alignment to business strategy.
•Lead work streams that supported data integrity, testing of system changes, report writing and analysing data flows for process improvement.
•Participated in SAP HCM projects and production support as an integral part of a cross-functional team in order to enhance existing applications or implementing new ones to support the delivery of Company Services.
•Partnered with the multiple teams to defined business requirements, assessed technology needs, and identify technical solutions for achieving business objectives.
•Defined and implemented strategy to support and enhance the TM module.
•Worked with global partners and client organizations to execute plans for the deployment of new SAP functionalities.
•Assisted with implementing and coordinating multiple business process changes, data accuracy audits and end user training.
•Configured SAP HCM systems to satisfy requests for fixes, changes, enhancements and compliance.
•Performed system administration, testing, troubleshooting and issue resolution for all SAP HCM systems.

positions.title: SAP HCM Consultant
positions.description:
•Analysed complex ideas or proposals and built a range of meaningful recommendations.
•Used multiple sources of information including broader stakeholder views to develop solutions and recommendations.
•Addressed sub-standard work or work that does not meet firm's/client's expectations
•Used data and insights to inform conclusions and support decision-making.
•Developed a point of view on key global trends, and how they impact clients.
•Managed a variety of viewpoints to build consensus and create positive outcomes for all parties.
•Simplified complex messages, highlighting and summarising key points.
•Uphold the firm's code of ethics and business conduct.
•Gathered business requirements through facilitating discovery and design workshops.
•Led functional discovery and design sessions, including the translation of business requirements into configuration elements.
•Prepared concise, polished deliverables, collaborating across teams as needed.
•Provided recommendations based on leading practices and relevant industry experience.
•Managed touchpoints with related SAP functional modules, including Core HCM, Core Compensation, Advanced Compensation, and Recruiting.

positions.title: SAP HCM Consultant
positions.description:
•Responsible for design, analysis, business process mapping, defined process flow and procedures, GAP Analysis & Blueprint work specific to SAP HCM, OM, PA, PT, and PY modules.
•Custom configuration and setting up of local payroll and tax processes.
•Post-production support, test plans, providing best solutions, the conduct of workshops, knowledge transfer, quality assurance, Preparation of manuals, and end-user training.

projects.title: Capital Group - RAPID
projects.description: RAPID (Results Analysis, Publication & Information Delivery) is Capital Group's platform for ingesting, validating, and publishing investment performance, attribution, and benchmark data to internal and external consumers. As SDET / Data Engineer at Infosys, I own testing from sprint stories to sign-off, validate output data against production with SQL and AI-assisted workflows, and debug across .NET, Python, and Angular. I also provide production support, monitoring batch runs with Datadog, Splunk, and Aptakube, triaging incidents, and verifying hotfixes, while helping modernize the platform by migrating on-prem SSIS batch jobs to Python and AWS Kubernetes and supporting releases through Harness CI/CD.

projects.title: Capital Group Company  - TOPS
projects.description:
Trade Operation Process System Migration Domain: Capital Markets

Project Overview: Led the QA strategy for the replacement of an outdated legacy application with a new Trade Operation Process System, ensuring seamless integration across various Capital Markets applications.

Team Leadership: Coordinated and mentored offshore development and testing teams, facilitating knowledge transfer regarding the application ecosystem, processes, and feature requirements to drive test execution to closure.

Testing Strategy & Execution: Designed and executed comprehensive test scenarios for over 50 user stories, covering functional, sanity, smoke, regression, and integration testing within an Agile environment.

Backend & Database Validation: Conducted rigorous backend testing using complex SQL queries on Oracle and Microsoft SQL databases to validate data integrity.

API & Automation: Performed API testing using Swagger and Postman, and implemented automation scripts using Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, and Java (TestNG/JUnit).

Defect Management: Utilized Splunk and Oracle OpenShift for log analysis to identify root causes. Managed the full defect lifecycle in Jira, collaborating with Business Analysts and Developers to resolve critical issues in production and lower environments.

Tech Stack: Java, C#, Angular, SQL (Oracle/MS SQL), Selenium, Cucumber, REST APIs, Postman, Splunk, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Unix, Bitbucket, Jira.

Technical Skills Summary
Testing & Automation: Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, JUnit, TestNG, Postman, Swagger, SDLC/STLC.

Languages & Scripting: Core Java, C#, Python, PL/SQL.

Tools & Platforms: Jira, Bitbucket, Git, Splunk, ServiceNow, AWS, Autosys.

Databases & Messaging: Oracle, Microsoft SQL, RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka.
